testcase.name: N100 Drop Viewer shows the killer's real chance for every bulk npc table at every bracket
N92 class - only the fixed rewards, the AFK area and test bots bypass the rate
N100 breach monsters - the unique chances get the rate, the regular lines are served rarest first, one line per roll
N92 rate command - the real rate command prints the rate the player really gains, every skill by name and by number in every bracket
N92 bonus XP is gone - with bonus-experience on, a login shows no bonus orb and no gain gets the time-played bonus
N100 Barrows chest - every roll stays one result, the rare lines get the bracket factor, the commons give way

testcase.name: N92 class - every skill gains exactly its bracket rate in every bracket and xpMultiplier tells the real gain
N100 Godwars Frozen key pieces - the hit window is rate times wider, capped, nothing above combat 134
N184 quest XP is exact, the Wolf Whistle reward and the Summoning kit follow the rate
N100 rolls that are not a monster kill stay 1x - boxes, chests, pickpockets, stalls and the bird-nest route
N92 red line - exactly once per rate change at 61, 81 and 96, never at relog, never for an existing account
N100 kill drops - rarest first, one pick per table, guaranteed and quantities stay, nested once
N92 class - no command or engine copy of the 2011 level curve call is left
N92 owner case - combat 138 with every skill 99 gains combat XP at 20x and skilling XP at 10x
N92 bonus XP command - the staff command that granted a bonus XP access which no longer does anything is gone
N92 rate command - skill aliases, unknown names and numbers outside the skill list never print a made-up rate
N349 every Deadman lamp gives exactly what the Emblem Trader says, at every bracket
N38 a lamp names the experience really gained, also at the 200M cap
N92 rate command - the owner's 138 account, a new account and the tier rise (never down)
